vague_phrases: in accordance with the retention policy

rules.title: Missing retention period
rules.remediation: Declare a retention period with a trigger event for this personal-data field, then record it on the ROPA.

rules.title: Vague retention period
rules.remediation: Replace pointers such as 'as per policy' with a concrete period and trigger (for example '30 days after last contact').

rules.title: No trigger event
rules.remediation: State when the clock starts (end of employment, last appointment, account closure), not only a duration.

rules.title: Retention not enforced
rules.remediation: Add an automated deletion or anonymisation job so the declared period is kept in practice.

rules.title: No disposal action
rules.remediation: Record whether the field is erased or anonymised when the period ends.

rules.title: Erasure not supported
rules.remediation: Confirm the field can be deleted or put beyond use so Article 17 requests can be met.

rules.title: Indefinite retention without Article 89 exception
rules.remediation: Set a finite period, or flag art89_exception only where the sole purpose is archiving, research, or statistics with safeguards.

rules.title: No ROPA activity link
rules.remediation: Map the field to an Article 30 processing activity id so the schema and the ROPA stay aligned.
